data.name: Hanaan
data.gender_notes: Hanaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-n-n' meaning 'grace' or 'graceful'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah bestows His grace upon those who are deserving, and the name Hanaan symbolizes this divine blessing. The name Hanaan carries the meaning “Graceful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hanaan usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine blessings and grace from Allah.
data.etymology: Hanaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hanaan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Hanaan
in_english.long_meaning: Hanaan is a unique and significant name in Islamic tradition, conveying the meanings of love, compassion, kindness, and happiness. It is one of Allah's beautiful names, mentioned in the Quran (Quran 20:49, 19:58). Hanaan is also associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) nickname, signifying kindness and generosity. This name embodies the Islamic values of compassion and mercy, and is considered a great name for a child, symbolizing the qualities of kindness, generosity, and loving nature.

data.spiritual_significance: More profoundly, the name Hanaan has a deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is a reminder of Allah's boundless mercy and compassion, and a call to strive towards being a gracious and compassionate person. The name Hanaan serves as a constant reminder of Allah's grace upon us and encourages us to be a vessel of His mercy in the world. The name is a beautiful manifestation of the faith's emphasis on the importance of compassion and kindness in our daily lives.
